model: Updated 100 mm controller: frozen joint policy plus learned two-gain wheel head, head_04

cohorts.known_regression_39: 39 known development/regression conditions; not unseen generalization
cohorts.predeclared_holdout_8: 8 predeclared conditions evaluated after checkpoint selection was frozen

measurement: Measured simulation state; posture metrics use native 120 Hz samples.

metric_windows.geometric_prefix: Start through each method's geometric completion. Failed episodes may not complete; main posture plots include only pairs where both methods strictly succeed.
metric_windows.full_episode: Entire method-specific episode, retained separately in the CSV. Do not substitute this window for geometric-prefix figures.

definitions.exact_body_tilt_rms_deg: Time RMS of total body inclination alpha = acos(cos(roll) * cos(pitch)), in degrees.
definitions.both_success: Intersection of common completion and native success (strict success).
definitions.paired_percent_change: 100 * (Residual PPO value / Recorded Replay value - 1); mean is the mean of per-case percentage changes.
definitions.target_gap_mm: Configured initial gap target, not a claim that every post-startup measured gap is identical.

limits: One frozen controller, selected conditions and simulation only.
No confidence intervals or statistical significance claim are inferred from these deterministic case suites.
Lower tilt RMS does not imply lower peak, pitch RMS or all support metrics.
Complete-controller comparisons do not isolate PPO as the sole cause.
